name: Ferrous Latitude Pictures
description: A mid-sized independent studio operating out of a licensed production space in Tier 3 Milwaukee corridor, Ferrous Latitude specializes in socially conscious holographic drama that skirts the edges of what Vantablack's licensing agreements permit. They are known for their willingness to portray corponation overreach with uncomfortable specificity, stopping just short of content that would trigger a ban. Their productions have attracted a devoted Tier 3 audience and a permanent Vantablack legal observation team.
cultural_impact: Demonstrated that a licensed independent studio could sustain a commercially viable audience while producing content that explicitly criticized corponation governance, creating a template other independents have attempted — with far less success — to replicate.
story_hooks: Ferrous Latitude's lead writer has gone dark two weeks before the release of their most politically sensitive production yet
A Vantablack acquisition offer has split the studio's founders — one wants to sell, one doesn't, and the deciding vote has disappeared
Someone has been leaking Ferrous Latitude scripts to Axiom's content review board before production wraps
